summary.implementedScope: Added the Story 0 archive foundation: shared archive/turn/view contracts and route builders, archive request error codes, server route schemas, Convex archive table skeletons, PlatformStore archive method seams across null/in-memory/Convex stores, a finalized-only process-history compatibility mapper, archive fixtures, and a contract test covering archive vocabulary and validation.

changedFiles.reason: Introduced canonical archive, turn, derived-view, pagination, refresh, error, and route-builder contracts for Epic 7.
Exported the new archive contract surface from the shared contract root.
Registered archive request error codes and status mappings in the shared request-error schema.
Added Fastify route schemas for archive list, turns list, derived-view list, and derived-view refresh.
Added named server error-code constants for archive conflict and invalid archive request handling.
Added the compatibility bridge that maps finalized compatible process-history items into archive append seeds without backfilling unsupported history rows.
Extended PlatformStore plus Null/Convex/InMemory implementations with archive entry, turn, and derived-view methods and archive pagination helpers.
Added archive entry validators and schema field skeletons for canonical archive rows.
Added derived turn validators and schema field skeletons for cached turn rows.
Added derived-view validators and schema field skeletons for structural view rows.
Registered archiveEntries, archiveTurns, and derivedArchiveViews tables and indexes in the Convex schema.
Added archive fixtures covering all entry kinds, degraded records, turns, derived views, pagination, and archive request errors.
Added Story 0 contract coverage for archive routes, entry vocabulary, refresh validation, fixtures, and compatibility mapping.
Updated the test PlatformStore double to satisfy the new archive method surface.
Updated the recording PlatformStore test double to satisfy the new archive method surface.
